title: Hi, I'm Jae
gallery_text: Inefficiency for Desirable Living: This simulated grasshopper model calculates desirability of the everyday walking experience in relation to total distance of the route, to the visibility of the target scenic view.

answers.interest: To simulate speculative design and create experimental models that may become a window into solving potential urban problems.
answers.suggestions: I haven't done enough research to know any good examples, but it would be interesting to learn more on those that involve behavior science and game theory.
